import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

# Data Collection
def collect_data():
    # Design a system to collect data on individual schedules

    data = {
        'schedule': ['9:00-10:00', '10:00-11:00', '11:00-12:00'],

        'constraints': ['no meeting', 'no lunch', 'no meeting']
    }

        'schedule': ['9:00-10:00', '10:00-11:00', '11:00-12:00'],
        'preferences': ['meeting', 'lunch', 'meeting'],
        'constraints': ['no meeting', 'no lunch', 'no meeting']
    }
    user_input_df = pd.DataFrame(user_input)
    optimized_schedule = model.predict(user_input_df)
    return optimized_schedule

    data = collect_data()
    model = train_model(data)
    optimized_schedule = display_schedule(model)
    return optimized_schedule

# Run the Main Function

    print(optimized_schedule)
